newsitem.title: UK: RTRS - S&P affirms Placer Dome ratings.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - S&P affirms Placer Dome ratings.

text.p: LONDON, Dec 2 - Standard & Poor's said it has affirmed its triple-B' corporate credit and senior unsecured debt ratings on Placer Dome Inc. following the company's announcement that it had bid to acquire Highlands Gold Ltd. and the minority interest in Placer Pacific Ltd.
The rating outlook remains positive. At the same time, Standard & Poor's also affirms Placer Dome's A-2' short-term rating.

Placer Dome has made a cash offer to acquire the shares of Highlands Gold Ltd. for total consideration of approximately US$340 million. Highlands Gold's major asset is a 25% interest in the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea. The purchase will be financed initially with bank debt which will be refinanced with a preferred share issue.

Placer Dome has also offered to purchase the 24.6% minority interest in its subsidiary, Placer Pacific Ltd, through a share exchange. Successful completion would require Placer Dome to issue approximately 10 million common shares with a value of about US$250 million based on the current share price.

These transactions should strengthen Placer Dome's business position somewhat. Its financial profile will become more risky until the additional bank debt is refinanced. However, ratios should still remain within the rating parameters. Placer Dome is also expected to take on further financial risk with the prospective project financing for Las Cristinas gold mine in Venezuela, Standard & Poor's said.
